area_overview: TrackGraph/disconnected graph traversal plus member/property helper APIs.
key_ideas: TrackGraph is for disconnected graphs where EF must decide Added/Modified/Unchanged/Deleted per node.
The callback receives a node with Entry and optional NodeState.
Tracking traversal can stop for a branch when the callback leaves the node Detached.
TrackGraph is the public shape behind EF's internal graph traversal used by Add/Attach/Update style operations.
Member/property helper APIs provide generic traversal over scalar properties and navigations.
